selection: One exact source per distinct dataset/text; balance approved Train voice requests by family, gender, age, timbre, delivery and vocal effort, then a stable seeded hash
mandatory_listening: Only selected representatives receive actual human listened/keep/discard decisions
other_originals: All source provenance, generation, split and technical checks remain; unlistened accepted originals are policy-admitted, never individually heard
optional_player: Read-only full frozen Hard pool; no answers, consent, listening flags or worker starts

migration.fresh_policy: Only unreviewed workflows up to the Hard review gate without saved or detached Hard answers or an existing Hard admission
migration.legacy_policy: Existing answered/completed Hard workflows retain their original queues, answers, dispositions and admission rules
migration.snapshot: workflow_before.json with its hash is retained before rebind
migration.execution: No automatic approval, TTS, feature extraction or model training

validation: 120 originals / six phrases select six unique phrase representatives reproducibly
real generated synthetic sources admit all originals from phrase representatives after technical and contract checks
legacy full phrase/family coverage, exact selection consent and prior discard/hold protection
read-only HTTP/player behavior and mandatory iframe reload only on changed queue hash
migration preserves artifacts, human inputs and history without starting a worker
claim: A reduced human review policy, not a guarantee that every unlistened pronunciation is correct
